[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]These shackles... They must be the reason[XENO:n ]
the Monado can't hurt people as well.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

Does that have something to do[XENO:n ]
with the faced Mechon?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
You must find that out by yourself.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
I will remove those shackles for you.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

But you must take the Monado[XENO:n ]
and free me from this prison.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

Free me, and the Monado will[XENO:n ]
cut down anything you wish.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
Nothing but a god can stand in your way![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]Don't do it, Shulk![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT6 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]Something's not right. The forefathers[XENO:n ]
must have had good reason to seal him![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT6 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]I need that power. I thought you[XENO:n ]
of all people would understand![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
I do...but... It's just...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Hold on a minute! He only said[XENO:n ]
he'd release this new power.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT19 ]Sounds like a good idea to me.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

I must do what I set out to.[XENO:n ]
The Machine God Soldiers must pay![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
